Develop more flexibility to increase range of movement and climb with greater efficiency

This 6-week program is designed for climbers with a foundation of flexibility training or climbers with a naturally high level of flexibility. This program schedules progressive flexibility sessions into a challenging weekly loading to help you build a greater range of movement.
